intro: The cryptocurrency, financial-services, and logistics sectors faced a concentrated wave of high-severity initial-access attacks between April 14 and April 30, 2026, according to ten reports. Threat actor UNC6692 was observed in these intrusions, which also affected general-business and shipping organizations. The severity mix included nine high-severity incidents and one medium-severity event, highlighting a persistent focus on gaining footholds across these industries during the period.
